newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Sasani to reverse list on JSE in Dec.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Sasani to reverse list on JSE in Dec.

text.p: Sasani Ltd, a South African entertainment and communications group will debut on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) in December through a reverse listing into cash shell Crendell Investment Corp Ltd.

Crendell's JSE listing is currently suspended. An offer will be made to Crendell minority shareholders and application made to transfer the listing to the JSE's media sector, a consortia of Sasani stakeholders said on Thursday.

Investors in the new company comprise two consortiums. One consists of film company Interleisure Ltd and video firm Video Lab Group which will together hold a 41.5 percent stake in Sasani. The other, also holding 41.5 percent, consists of black empowerment group Msomi Ventures, an investment house and an advertising consortium.
The public will hold 17 percent of the shares, the consortia said.
They said Sasani will buy Video Lab's business from joint owners Interleisure and Video Lab management for 90.5 million rand to be settled by cash of 45 million and a share issue.
Sasani intends to raise the cash through a rights issue of 51 million rand.
The video business will form the core of Sasani's business and act as a platform for expansion locally and offshore.
